naslov: Claude Code will no longer clone existing games, even under a different name
opis:
Around October 27, Anthropic switched on a new server-side rule for Claude Code (internal flag tengu_heron_brook). Claude now refuses to build a copy of an existing game, even if you give it a different name. Users can't turn the rule off.

Why it matters: If you build games with Claude Code, "make me X, but different" no longer works.

naslov: Anthropic adds text watermarks to older models too, but two of them are easy to bypass
opis:
Ahead of the EU AI Act's December deadline, Anthropic is adding an invisible text watermark to four more models: Mythos 5, Opus 4.7, Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6. Newer models, like Opus 5.5, already have it. The mark is hidden in word choice and adds no tokens, and users can't turn it off.

Why it matters: If your EU compliance setup relies on this watermark, don't touch the sampling parameters on those two models.

naslov: Google admits AI Mode cuts its search revenue, stock down about 15%
opis:
Google's chief business officer Philipp Schindler said AI Mode, the search experience where AI gives the answers, has grown quickly but earns less than classic results. According to AINews, the stock fell about 15%, roughly $500 billion in value and the biggest drop since the 2004 IPO.

Why it matters: AI answers in search are sending fewer people to websites, and now it hurts Google itself.

naslov: Try Lightpanda: A headless browser, meaning a browser with no window, written from scratch in…
opis:
A headless browser, meaning a browser with no window, written from scratch in Zig for AI agents and automation.

How to try it:
1. On Mac: brew install lightpanda-io/browser/lightpanda
2. Start the server: lightpanda serve --host 127.0.0.1 --port 9222
3. In an existing Puppeteer script, use puppeteer.connect({ browserWSEndpoint: "ws://127.0.0.1:9222" })
4. For Claude Code: add the lightpanda command with the argument ["mcp"] to your MCP config

Price: free (AGPL-3.0)

Official link: https://github.com/lightpanda-io/browser
